Body.Content:
Dynatrace for Azure is a natively integrated software as a service (SaaS) solution that provides deep cloud observability for proactive identification and resolution of issues impacting mission critical applications. 

The tight Azure integration enables one-click provisioning and configuration through the Azure Portal and effortless navigation through single sign-on. You can monitor cloud applications with secure and seamless dataflow to Dynatrace, including shipping logs and metrics. Purchase Dynatrace through the Azure Marketplace, get a unified bill for all services you use on Azure, and leverage existing enterprise agreements. Dynatrace for Azure public preview will be available in June 2022.

Learn more.
